articles.title: Culture & Arts 文化与艺术
articles.summary: Heritage preservation, digital museums and cultural exchange.

sentences.orig: The restoration of the ancient monument, a project spanning nearly a decade, has been hailed as a triumph of cultural preservation.
sentences.trans: 这座古老纪念碑的修复工程历时近十年，被誉为文化遗产保护的胜利。

sentences.orig: Museums are embracing digital technology, offering virtual tours that make their collections accessible to a global audience.
sentences.trans: 博物馆正在拥抱数字技术，提供虚拟参观，让全球观众都能欣赏其藏品。

sentences.orig: The film industry has undergone profound transformation, with streaming platforms reshaping how audiences consume content.
sentences.trans: 电影业经历了深刻变革，流媒体平台正在重塑观众的消费方式。

sentences.orig: Cultural heritage, from traditional crafts to intangible practices, plays a vital role in shaping national identity.
sentences.trans: 从传统工艺到非物质文化遗产，文化遗产在塑造民族认同方面发挥着重要作用。

sentences.orig: The government has allocated substantial funding to support emerging artists and independent cultural initiatives.
sentences.trans: 政府已拨出大量资金支持新兴艺术家和独立文化项目。

sentences.orig: Critics argue that commercialisation threatens the authenticity of traditional art forms, reducing them to tourist attractions.
sentences.trans: 批评者认为，商业化威胁传统艺术形式的真实性，使其沦为旅游景点。

sentences.orig: International cultural exchanges foster mutual understanding and serve as a bridge between diverse societies.
sentences.trans: 国际文化交流增进相互理解，成为连接不同社会的桥梁。

sentences.orig: The literary world has witnessed a resurgence of interest in translated fiction, broadening readers' horizons beyond national borders.
sentences.trans: 文学界见证了翻译小说兴趣的复苏，拓宽了读者的国际视野。
